title: Naruto Uzumaki
summary: Naruto Uzumaki is the central protagonist of Naruto, a loud and determined shinobi from the Hidden Leaf Village who wants to become Hokage and earn the village's respect.

title: Sasuke Uchiha
summary: Sasuke Uchiha is Naruto's rival and teammate on Team 7. He is highly skilled, emotionally guarded, and driven by revenge and personal strength.

title: Sakura Haruno
summary: Sakura Haruno is Naruto's teammate on Team 7. She combines strong chakra control, intelligence, and later medical-ninjutsu expertise.

title: Kakashi Hatake
summary: Kakashi Hatake is the leader of Team 7, known for his calm judgment, elite combat ability, and emphasis on teamwork.

title: Iruka Umino
summary: Iruka Umino is one of Naruto's earliest mentors and one of the first adults to openly care for and acknowledge him.

title: Kurama
summary: Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Fox, is the tailed beast sealed inside Naruto. Their relationship changes over time from hostility to cooperation.

title: Konoha
summary: Konoha, also called the Hidden Leaf Village, is Naruto's home village and a central political and military power in the series.

title: Hokage
summary: The Hokage is the leader of the Hidden Leaf Village. Naruto's long-term dream is to become Hokage so he can protect the village and be acknowledged by everyone.

title: Chakra
summary: Chakra is the core energy system used by shinobi to perform techniques such as ninjutsu, genjutsu, and taijutsu-enhanced combat.

title: Shadow Clone Jutsu
summary: Shadow Clone Jutsu is one of Naruto's signature techniques. It creates physical clones that can fight and act independently instead of being simple illusions.

title: Rasengan
summary: The Rasengan is a high-level chakra technique built from concentrated rotational chakra. It becomes one of Naruto's defining attacks.

title: Team 7
summary: Team 7 includes Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Sakura Haruno, and Kakashi Hatake as their sensei. Their dynamic is central to the early story.

title: Naruto's Goal
summary: Naruto's core motivation is to be recognized, protect his friends, and become Hokage without giving up on his personal ninja way.
